rules: Unique items use unique stable ITEM IDs.
Stacking is allowed only when item type, condition, ownership, and relevant metadata are equivalent.
Inventory mass contributes to carried load and action validation.
Legal status is jurisdiction-specific and may be UNKNOWN.
Item destruction creates a tombstone/event; stable IDs are never reused.
Containers have finite capacity and access requirements.
Equipment effects apply only while equipped and physically present.
